release_notes: Autopilot now continuously checks the YouTube, Facebook, branded tracker and website connections without interrupting normal work.
Temporary network/API failures are saved as Recovering and retried automatically with increasing backoff instead of repeatedly demanding manual attention.
Successful retries clear the failure state automatically when a service comes back online.
Authentication/account/configuration failures are separated from transient failures and shown as Needs setup rather than being hammered with rapid retries.
Recovery state persists across app restarts in autopilot-recovery.json and individual subsystem failures remain isolated.
The Autopilot home reflects Recovering or Needs setup while all unaffected automation continues normally.
